Description: "We produce a lot more wind energy in Texas than California does," says Senator @tedcruz. "They produce a lot of hot air, but the wind energy is produced in Texas." https://t.co/QvSsiE8ip1

external_links_info.description: The state boasts extremely high wind speeds, particularly in North and West Texas, and along the southern Gulf Coast, Overbye said. For example, the average peak wind speed in El Paso in West Texas hit 35.9 mph in April 2022, the El Paso Times reported.
